scope: Source-pinned intrinsic damage ownership for Shenhe E/Q and Chongyun E; no claim of game verification.

shenhe.skill.press-hit.state: Original ai captured; live Snapshot, c4 consumption and player/primary-target selection remain at task execution. Particle callback has no damage spawn.

shenhe.skill.hold-hit.state: Original ai captured; live Snapshot, c4 consumption and player-centered area remain at task execution. Particle callback has no damage spawn.

shenhe.burst.snapshot-and-dots.cancellation: None in original producer or queued attacks; status expiry does not cancel them.
shenhe.burst.snapshot-and-dots.state: Local ai/count/ap are captured. Snapshot stays inside original47f callback before same-frame buff refresh; fixed burst position, original FIFO ordering retained.

chongyun.skill.a4-expiry.cancellation: src != c.fieldSrc yields fact attack-count=0; otherwise queue once and fact1.

chongyun.skill.a4-replacement.rootGate: ascension>=4 and original existing field branch
chongyun.skill.a4-replacement.ownership: Registered by the new invocation before resnapshotting/replacing the area; producer retains that exact invocation while formula snapshot retains old values.
chongyun.skill.a4-replacement.cancellation: Same original src gate as natural timer; later recast can cancel either task.

facts.chongyun.skill.replaced-field: Invocation fact initialized0; recorded1 only inside original Duration>0 branch, no extra query.
facts.chongyun.skill.a4.attack-count: Producer fact0 immediately before original src-mismatch return; fact1 immediately before the sole actual attack queue.

nativeOwnership: Existing Core.SourceHostQueueTask -> RegisterAbilityProducer -> BindAbilityProducerTask retains actual invocation/action sequence and task origin. Each producer contains only attacks it queues. No frame/ability-name inference or new ownership primitive.
nonDamageAudit: 点按/长按命中回调仅产球；原增益任务只授予冰翎层数/状态与A4修饰器。冰翎钩子改当前击FlatDmg，C4追加回调只计层数，c4()消费层数仅修改当前技能快照DmgP。两lane授予冰翎的A4门控存在源码差异，未规范化。
burst.go:90-128仅刷新A1/C2增益与冰/物抗减益。Init安装冰翎同击附加；quillDamageMod及C4回调只改当前击/层数、不另排伤害。CD1200f及4f耗能原位保留。
particleCB只产球；A4回调只减抗、C4只回能。领域创建/附魔/A1攻速/C2冷却减免与换人钩子不另排攻击。新E的replacement使用旧a4Snap/旧skillArea，但其原生登记归属当前E；旧计时器仍属于旧E，可被src失配取消。C1额外冰刃仅来自后续普攻，不属于E。
laneDifferences: Shenhe burst.go and Chongyun asc.go are identical between PRE123 lanes.

Shenhe skill.go differs: Classic queues skillPressBuff/skillHoldBuff only at ascension>=4 and those functions grant quills plus A4 buffs. Stellar queues quill grants unconditionally and separately calls a4PressBuff/a4HoldBuff with their own ascension gate. Both damage callbacks queue exactly one intrinsic hit; wrappers preserve all original lane-specific non-damage semantics.
Chongyun skill.go C2 scalar branch differs: Stellar includes ActionSpecialSkill and char-scalar-chongyun-c2-a7; Classic uses skill/burst and b4. Separate copies preserve this difference untouched.
unchangedMechanics: All original callbacks, scheduling delays, snapshot calls, target selection, status and modifier writes are retained at original execution sites.
No hard-coded total for Chongyun cancellation/replacement. No overlap prohibition or unsupported-state gate.
Zero-output cancellation producers must still finish; pending timers remain unresolved, and each queued attack needs native dispatch completion.
Other characters, event-triggered damage components, healing/energy components and team reaction ownership are not reclassified.
integrationConcern: Latest built122 Shenhe second assignment ai=AttackInfo had uninstrumented burstdot talent read; parent notified to check generic talent-instrumenter support. These source-only ownership patches do not replace formula provenance.
